chapters.label: The goal, live
chapters.text: Milan, 1990, the World Cup! West Germany's captain, Lothar Matthäus, picks up the ball deep in his own half. He runs... and runs... fifty metres! Then a hard drive... Goal!

chapters.label: Watch it again
chapters.text: Watch it again, from low down. Big strides, head up, the ball pushed out in front. Nobody stops him. Then bang!

chapters.label: From behind the goal
chapters.text: From behind the goal: the keeper stretches, but he can't stop it! Three-one!

chapters.label: The secret
chapters.text: The secret? Box-to-box players help defend and attack, covering the whole pitch. Start near your own goal, carry it forward, then shoot!
